newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Sapura Group said seeking stake in UMW.
newsitem.headline: Sapura Group said seeking stake in UMW.

text.p: Malaysia's Sapura Group has submitted an offer to buy a 32 percent stake in vehicle concern UMW Holdings Bhd, the Asian Wall Street Journal reported on Friday.
The newspaper said a senior Finance Ministry official confirmed Sapura's offer submission. Officials at the ministry, Sapura and UMW were not available for comment on Friday.
Sapura is a diversified telecommunications and cable maker.
The stake is said to be purchased from UMW's main shareholder Permodalan Nasional Bhd (PNB), Malaysia's national investment corporation, the newspaper said. PNB currently owns 40 percent of UMW.
If successful, Sapura's bid would give it management control over UMW, the Journal said.
The ministry official said that Finance Minister Anwar Ibrahim, who oversees management of PNB, had not made any decision on the matter, the article said.
UMW owns the Toyota automobile distribution franchise in Malaysia and a 38 percent interest in Malaysia's second national car project, Perusahaan Otomobil Kedua Sdn Bhd.
